rgtm_pno.note: The verified publisher MIDI archive is empty. The record GitHub link leads to an EDM drum repository rather than piano labels. Do not use unlabeled audio as note/hold truth.

pianovam.note: Both checked primary pages impose noncommercial use. The paper CC BY license is not the dataset grant. No files acquired.

requirements: Only no_license_conflict and all_valid records with compatible per-score rights
Verify known public-domain composition and score license before selection
Group alternate arrangements, transpositions and shared works across all existing corpora before audio
Use actual rendered key clocks; no claim of human offsets or pedal truth
Keep independent real-piano release gain gates
cautions: Instrument code 0 is not proof of piano intent; most program-zero composers are unknown.
Substring composer matching admits mixed attributions and unrelated modern composers; it is not an acquisition rule.
Catalog best_path groups merge several differently numbered Scarlatti sonatas. Use conservative connected work/composer groups, not filename splits.
No automatic transcription labels may be treated as independent human key truth.

sky_piano.note: The project states per-modality license terms but the checked page did not provide a usable commercial audio/MIDI grant. No files acquired.
